carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear features are visible along the lateral surface of the caudal peduncle, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal edge to shadow on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent vertical high-luminance linear mark is visible at the insertion point where the caudal peduncle meets the upper lobe of the caudal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The caudal fin displays several high-luminance circular spots, including a distinct vertical arrangement of three spots on the lower lobe and scattered individual spots on the posterior edge of the upper lobe.
